checks.requirement_or_scenario: R2-01 through R2-06 accountless partner intake
checks.method_or_action: Submit organisation, contact, title, description, capacity, and one or more areas without signing in
checks.setup: Use the supplied R2 intake fixture once imported; submissions remain pending initially.
checks.expected_behavior: Valid data creates an awaiting-supervisor record; missing organisation, contact email, title, or area is rejected and partner data never appears publicly.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R2-07 through R2-15 faculty supervision and coordination
checks.method_or_action: Verified faculty signs in, records willingness, and optionally records engagement.
checks.setup: Use a linked, verified faculty fixture account through the passwordless test-mode flow.
checks.expected_behavior: First willingness publishes the opportunity, additional willingness remains allowed, visible interest count is updated, and withdrawing the last willingness returns it to awaiting-supervisor.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R2-16 through R2-20 subscriptions and notifications
checks.method_or_action: Save all-area or selected-area subscriptions, then submit a matching opportunity.
checks.setup: Save a subscription before submitting the matching intake fixture.
checks.expected_behavior: An in-product notification is created for matching future submissions; settings and notifications remain faculty-private.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R2-21 through R2-25 student discovery and authorization
checks.method_or_action: Browse while logged out; compare pending versus supervised opportunity visibility.
checks.setup: At least one opportunity has a verified faculty supervisor; use an unverified account for negative authorization checks.
checks.expected_behavior: Only supervised opportunities appear, students see the opportunity source and supervisors rather than partner contacts, and an unverified user receives 403 for coordination routes.

fixture_setup: Run schema.sql against Supabase, seed the existing R1 fixture, then use npm --prefix backend run seed:r2 to import the tracked official R2 fixture bundle. The importer intentionally replaces only the accepted official fixture submission IDs, so use it for a controlled fixture reset rather than routine production operation. Do not deduplicate submissions by organisation or title; submission identifiers are the only fixture identity.
test_access: Use the instructor-approved passwordless test-mode challenge. Provide linked verified-faculty, unverified-faculty, and staff/admin account details only in the approved private course channel; no passwords or tokens are committed.
